'''Bombers''' is an Australian team named after its owners, the Australian Football League's Essendon Football Club (nicknamed the Bombers).

== History ==
The '''Bombers''' were announced on December 14, 2017 when Essendon became the second AFL team to enter ''League of Legends'' after their acquisition of OPL team [[Abyss Esports]]. However, unlike with Adelaide after they acquired [[Legacy Esports]] in May 2017, Abyss updated their branding alongside the acquisition.<ref>[http://www.theage.com.au/afl/afl-news/essendon-bombers-buy-australian-esports-team-abyss-20171207-h00vmw.html  Essendon Bombers buy Australian esports team Abyss] ''theage.com.au''</ref> The club also announced plans to relocate the team from Sydney, where the OPL is played, to Melbourne, where the club is based in Tullamarine.
